exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 299 women who delivered in the 1st Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Medical University of Warsaw.
finding: Caesarean section was associated with significantly higher TGF-beta2 concentrations in human colostrum.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with increased levels of TGF-beta2 in human colostrum.
